title: GPT Image 2 (OpenAI)
summary: A unified multimodal foundation model from OpenAI released in April 2026 that replaced the DALL-E series. It introduces native reasoning ('Thinking Mode'), near-perfect typography across multiple scripts, and native 4K resolution support.
research_notes: First image generation model to feature a native reasoning step for complex spatial planning and self-correction. Available via API as gpt-image-2.

evolution.summary: Officially succeeded DALL-E 3; OpenAI retired the entire DALL-E brand on May 12, 2026, to consolidate image generation under the GPT multimodal architecture. It currently leads the Image Arena leaderboard.
